title: Postcards — Seal Types
description: post-cards/data/seals/seals.json. The postmark/cancellation-mark styles PostcardSeals.drawSeal knows how to render; two are picked per postcard by its seeded RNG.

types.description: Each entry must be a seal type implemented in postcard-seals.js (e.g. cds, wavyLines, sloganCancel, ...).
